historical_record.description: Built as a commercial building, associated with San Francisco Design Center.

Built for the San Francisco Development Company as the northernmost of three near-identical brick warehouses on the block, designed by Meyers & Ward. Known as the Bernhard Mattress Company and John Hoey warehouse.
Bought together with the warehouse next door and converted into the Galleria Design Center.
